::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Linearized Amplifier Technologies and Services, incubated at IIT Roorkee's iHUB DivyaSampark. Lists a 13–17 GHz 8-bit phase-shifter chip in TSMC 65nm CMOS and a radar front-end chip as products, alongside GaN power-amplifier modules and mm-wave packaging.
:::

## What does this firm design?

RF front-end chips (phase shifters, radar front-ends, CMOS/BiCMOS RFIC IP), GaN MMICs and power-amplifier modules.
